title: Fire & Life Safety Awareness
outcome: Notice everyday risks, review a private plan and rehearse a safer decision within awareness limits.
outcomeMs: Kenal pasti risiko harian, semak pelan peribadi dan latih keputusan yang lebih selamat dalam skop kesedaran.

title: First Aid / CPR / AED Awareness
outcome: Rehearse a fictional response conversation and role handoff, then identify readiness and further-training needs.
outcomeMs: Latih perbualan respons dan penyerahan peranan melalui situasi rekaan, kemudian kenal pasti keperluan persediaan dan latihan lanjut.
alt: Illustrative CPR and AED learning image

title: Online Security & Fraud Prevention
outcome: Practise independent verification and carry out one permitted account or privacy review, or an equivalent simulation.
outcomeMs: Latih pengesahan secara bebas dan lakukan satu semakan akaun atau privasi yang dibenarkan, atau simulasi yang setara.

title: Community Emergency Preparedness
outcome: Create and rehearse a private household readiness pack with clear information, communication and support arrangements.
outcomeMs: Sediakan dan latih penggunaan pek kesiapsiagaan isi rumah secara peribadi, dengan maklumat, komunikasi dan aturan sokongan yang jelas.
